layers.name: cmd
layers.description: CLI entry point using Cobra. Parses flags, wires dependencies, and delegates to internal packages. This is the composition root.

layers.name: reviewer
layers.description: Review orchestration layer. Implements the three-layer review pipeline (intent, structural, style), constructs prompts for each layer, fans out to multiple models in parallel, and aggregates results.

layers.name: graph
layers.description: Code graph data model, SQLite persistence, and blast-radius computation. Stores nodes (functions, types, interfaces) and edges (calls, interface satisfaction), and computes the scoped subgraph affected by a given diff.

layers.name: analyzer
layers.description: Language-specific AST parsing. Uses go/ast and go/types to extract nodes and edges from Go source. Defines the LanguageAnalyzer interface for future language support (Rust, Elixir via Tree-sitter).

layers.name: provider
layers.description: LLM provider abstraction. Implements backends for Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), and OpenAI (Codex/GPT). Handles authentication, API calls, rate limiting, and response parsing.

layers.name: output
layers.description: Structured review output formatting. Renders findings to terminal and generates markdown files. Groups findings by review layer and model.

layers.name: config
layers.description: Configuration loading and model registry. Reads CLI config files, manages provider credentials, and defines the model selection types.
